en: A vintage postcard showing a sepia-toned photograph of a broad city street lined with large, ornate buildings and a park-like area with trees and benches. The street is titled 'Sundsvall, Parti av Storgatan', indicating a part of the main street in Sundsvall, Sweden. The reverse side shows a Swedish postage stamp (10 öre), handwritten text, address, and postmarks dated '27.6.23'.
